title: Version PWA precache and runtime cache update behavior
acceptance_criteria: The service worker precaches the built app shell using a clearly versioned cache name and handles failed optional precache entries without aborting installation.
Runtime GET requests use an explicit strategy with opaque/error responses handled safely and non-GET requests bypass the cache.
Activation removes stale Move Well cache versions and claims clients after cleanup.
A new service worker has a documented update path that does not silently strand users on stale assets; registration failures are non-fatal.
Cache names and update behavior are deterministic and do not cache user-sensitive local data or non-GET requests.
The generated production bundle contains the service worker and the service worker passes syntax validation.
completion_summary: Implemented versioned PWA precache/runtime caching, stale cleanup, safe updates, non-fatal registration, and documentation.
